prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: See Journ. Anthr. Inst., Vol. 34, p. 129.An old Mura-Mura went away from Dítjimínka to beget childrenLiterally: child lay down for oneself from kurala = to lay. far away, the Jélkapálupáluna and other children, namely his [known] girls.This refers to the known girls appearing in the Wápia legend (Howitt, l. c., p. 119). [After these had increased in number] there was a confusion, so that some old men agreed to separate [the people into classes]. [They said:] You who belong to the caterpillar-madu, go and beget crow children, you who belong to the crow-madu, go and beget emu children. Live only in your area, in which your Mura-Mura once roamed.
